title: Precognitive dream of the Focus magazine

tellings.quote: And there in the middle of the living room floor, just as I had dreamt, was a magazine. I picked it up. It was called Focus.

plain: The researcher of psychic phenomena Jeffrey Mishlove says that in 1972, living in married student housing in Berkeley, California, he dreamt of a magazine on his living room floor and then found one there, "just as I had dreamt," called Focus, the magazine of the public broadcaster KQED. He tells Michels this from his own life and mentions the writer Eric Wargo, who writes on dreams that foresee the future. He links it to the same night he dreamt of a great-uncle visiting at the moment of his death; if true, the dream would have shown him something before it happened.
